claim_boundary: Certifies Schwartz kernels, the two-sided cutoff Pauli--Jordan bisolution, absence of one-sided zero covectors, factorwise metric-null wavefront confinement, and regularity of the internal compact-slab time-slice source map. It does not exclude same-orientation wavefront sectors, construct a free-to-full GreenHyp response morphism, supply a formally Hermitian graded GreenHyp object, transport a seed covariance, verify BRST Ward identities, construct a Hadamard state, prove positivity, restore a QME, or establish a quantum theory.

cutoff_kernel_theorem.Schwartz_kernel: G_chi,+/-, and hence E_chi=G_chi,advanced-G_chi,retarded, possess distribution kernels
cutoff_kernel_theorem.certified_inclusion: WF(E_chi) subset (N_plus union N_minus) x (N_plus union N_minus)
cutoff_kernel_theorem.continuity: all finite-slab Sobolev estimates globalize to continuous G_chi,+/-:C_c^infinity to C^infinity maps
cutoff_kernel_theorem.elliptic_regularization: the two bisolution equations confine each nonzero covector separately to Char(C_chi)=N_plus union N_minus
cutoff_kernel_theorem.one_sided_exclusion: continuity of E_chi and its formal transpose excludes kernel wavefront pairs with exactly one zero covector
